mission_states.name: nominal_operations
mission_states.description: Routine command, telemetry, and scheduled mission activity.

mission_states.name: low_power_or_eclipse
mission_states.description: Energy-constrained state in which survival reserve and power-positive operation dominate payload continuity.

mission_states.name: software_update_or_recovery
mission_states.description: Software or configuration transition requiring integrity, authorization, rollback, and state-convergence evidence.

events.name: unauthorized_or_replayed_command
events.description: A syntactically valid command is submitted using an unauthorized identity, invalid mission-state authorization, or stale/replayed authorization context.

events.name: modified_or_unauthorized_update
events.description: A synthetic software or configuration artifact is modified, downgraded, incorrectly authorized, or interrupted during installation.

events.name: telemetry_suppression_during_response
events.description: Selected synthetic telemetry or trust evidence is delayed, suppressed, or made unavailable during response and recovery.

response_policies.name: observe_only
response_policies.description: Record and alert without automatic containment.

response_policies.name: identity_or_source_isolation
response_policies.description: Revoke the modeled identity or isolate the synthetic source while preserving unaffected command paths.

response_policies.name: selective_command_restriction
response_policies.description: Block predeclared high-risk command classes while allowing authorized low-risk operations.

response_policies.name: safe_mode_transition
response_policies.description: Enter a sustainable, commandable, evidence-preserving safe state subject to frozen invariants.

response_policies.name: rollback
response_policies.description: Restore an approved software or configuration state using verified artifacts and recovery evidence.

response_policies.name: mission_aware_selection
response_policies.description: Select among bounded actions using mission state, event evidence, contact availability, resource state, and safety/trust constraints.

evidence_conditions.name: full_evidence
evidence_conditions.description: All applicable synthetic telemetry and recovery evidence are available within configured timing bounds.

evidence_conditions.name: reduced_or_suppressed_telemetry
evidence_conditions.description: A predeclared subset of telemetry or trust evidence is unavailable, delayed, or stale.
